<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<title>Ethical Free Fire Panel — ₹1,299</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#0b0d10;--card:#141820;--muted:#aeb6c4;--text:#f7f8fb;--gold:#ffbd3d;--green:#27d98a;--line:#2a303b}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 75% 0%,#263019 0,transparent 30%),var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}
.wrap{width:min(1100px,92%);margin:auto}.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:22px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.brand{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.4px}.brand span{color:var(--gold)}.pill{font-size:12px;color:#bfffe0;border:1px solid #286d50;background:#123224;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:42px;align-items:center;padding:54px 0 46px}
.eyebrow{color:var(--gold);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:2px;font-size:12px}
h1{font-size:clamp(36px,6vw,62px);line-height:1.02;margin:15px 0 18px;letter-spacing:-1.8px}
p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7}.price{font-size:34px;font-weight:900;margin:22px 0 5px}.old{font-size:15px;color:#7e8795;text-decoration:line-through;font-weight:500;margin-left:8px}
.actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:24px 0}.btn{border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 19px;font-weight:850;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px}.primary{background:var(--gold);color:#17120a}.secondary{background:#202630;color:#fff;border:1px solid #394150}
.small{font-size:12px;color:#8791a0}.art{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1d232c,#111419);padding:18px;border:1px solid #343b46;border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 22px 70px #0007}
.art img{display:block;width:100%;max-height:490px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:14px;background:#090a0c}.art-caption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:13px 3px 2px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin:18px 0 52px}.feature,.section{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:22px}.feature b{display:block;margin:10px 0 5px}.feature p{font-size:14px;margin:0}
section{padding:12px 0 38px}.section h2{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:25px}.review-empty{border:1px dashed #414956;border-radius:13px;padding:18px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:15px}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:25px 0 40px;color:#7f8997;font-size:12px}
.modal-backdrop{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000b;z-index:10;padding:18px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.modal-backdrop.show{display:flex}.modal{width:min(500px,100%);background:#151a22;border:1px solid #394150;border-radius:20px;padding:24px;max-height:90vh;overflow:auto}.modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}.close{background:#2a303a;color:white;border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer}.upi{background:#0b0e13;border:1px solid #303744;border-radius:12px;padding:13px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.upi strong{font-size:14px}.notice{font-size:13px;padding:12px;border-radius:10px;background:#322918;color:#ffe1a1;line-height:1.55}.modal .btn{width:100%;margin-top:10px}.qr-placeholder{border:1px dashed #4b5360;border-radius:12px;padding:22px;text-align:center;color:#b7c0ce;margin:15px 0}.qr-placeholder .symbol{font-size:32px}
@media(max-width:760px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px;padding-top:35px}.art{order:-1}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.nav{gap:12px}.pill{font-size:10px}h1{letter-spacing:-1px}}
</style>
</head>
